full_track.tags: Classical crossover and operatic pop featuring a dramatic tenor vocal performance. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing arpeggiated chords and a lush orchestral string section providing sustained legato pads and counter-melodies. A cinematic percussion section enters later with deep orchestral bass drums and shimmering cymbals. The vocal style is characterized by bel canto technique, utilizing wide vibrato and powerful chest voice transitions into head voice. The tempo is a rubato-heavy 72 BPM in the key of G Major. The production features high-fidelity hall reverb on both the vocals and the strings, creating a wide stereo image.
